axioms: Aggregation and Disaggregation are subclasses of Permission
Contract parties have roles within Permission/Duty elements
NOT is an operator used in expressions/constraints
All contract parties can have rights and duties
AND, OR, XOR are operators for constraints
Conditions can be expressed via Constraints
Containers are a concept that might be removed
Sequencing might be a part of REL
Policies can be linked to assets
Duties can be remedies for prohibition violations
Rules can be activated upon failure of other rules
Duties can have consequences that are other duties
